race.comment: BACASH (2) will be hopping over the border after finishing midfield, and not too far off the placings at Mornington 3 weeks ago when fresh from a spell. he has not missed a cheque in 3 starts second-up in the past, and with the aid of a 3kg claim, he is perfectly placed to take this out. FROM THE BLOCK (1) has been well placed to win 2 of his 3 most recent starts, and he remains in a similar field here, A 2kg claim will reduce his top weight, and he would only need some luck from his very wide draw to be a top 4 threat again. ANOTHERHOUSE (7) franked a recent trial win with a comfortable win fresh up a fortnight ago. He has a good record here over this trip, and Rochelle Milnes will give him every chance of repeating the dose, despite a wide gate. RONNY BEE (16) was in the money in all 3 starts last prep when following his trainer to this State from NSW earlier in the year. He has plenty of talent, and will be ready to rumble fresh up. IMAMANZOR (14) resumes, and can't be risked.
